items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Bricktop; the interviewer mentions Bricktop in the context of another person ('he was married to Bricktop').

ctx.x: Yeah. He stood over the waters a long time.
Yeah, but he came back. He was married to Bricktop, you know. I was going to ask you some of your favorite musicians were through the years. Who was some of the best clarinet players you've heard?
Well the best I ever heard Ron Yarlene was uh... Andy? Andy and T.O.
